author: claude
summary: New frontend/src/hooks/useMediaQuery.ts hook (task 005 of the backlog-batch-mobile-mode-and-cleanup plan) -- foundation for ChapterEditor's upcoming minimal mobile mode. Uses useSyncExternalStore over window.matchMedia, mirroring this repo's existing useDevMode (frontend/src/utils/devMode.ts) convention rather than introducing a new state-subscription pattern. Not yet wired into any consumer -- that happens in a later task (DirectorsConsole mobile filtering).

files.change: New hook: useMediaQuery(query: string): boolean, subscribes to window.matchMedia(query) change events via useSyncExternalStore, same pattern as useDevMode.
New test file: matchMedia mock that dispatches real 'change' events, covers match-true, match-false, and re-render-on-change.
